T: We're on a mission from food.
D: Two brothers reunite their blues band to save their childhood orphanage.
P: Serve the mains when they walk into the Soul Food Cafe.
S: Aretha's diner, where Matt quits the band to rejoin
Cornmeal and flour with buttermilk, egg, grated onion and a pinch of sugar, spooned into 175C oil and fried until golden. Hot sauce butter to dip.
behind the chicken wire, both kinds of music
Peanuts in the shell roasted at 180C for 20 minutes, tossed hot with salt and cayenne, served in a tin bucket.
M: Jake's order at the Soul Food Cafe
Chicken pieces brined overnight in buttermilk and hot sauce, double-dredged in seasoned flour, fried at 165C until 74C inside. Pile them high, all four.
Elwood's order, plus what Aretha would serve
Thick white toast, dry, with collard greens braised 90 minutes with a smoked ham hock, onion and a splash of vinegar.
W: Sister Mary Stigmata keeps a ruler handy
Plain Scottish shortbread cut into dead-straight fingers, pricked in neat rows and dusted with sugar.
K: four chickens and a cola, Jake's order
Cola in glass bottles, ice cold, with a straw.

s.note: Aretha's diner, where Matt quits the band to rejoin
s.how: Mix 150g cornmeal, 75g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp sugar, 1 grated onion, 1 egg and 200ml buttermilk. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until golden. Melt 60g butter with 2 tbsp hot sauce for dipping.

s.note: behind the chicken wire, both kinds of music
s.how: Spread 400g peanuts in the shell on a tray and roast at 180C for 20 minutes. Toss straight away with fine salt and a pinch of cayenne. Tip into a tin bucket, behind chicken wire if you can manage it.

m.note: Jake's order at the Soul Food Cafe
m.how: Brine 1.5kg chicken pieces overnight in 500ml buttermilk with 2 tbsp hot sauce. Dredge twice in 300g flour seasoned with salt and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Fry at 165C until 74C inside, about 14 minutes. Pile them high on a platter.

w.note: Sister Mary Stigmata keeps a ruler handy
w.how: Beat 250g soft butter with 110g caster sugar, then work in 300g plain flour and 60g rice flour. Press into a lined 20 by 30cm tin, prick in neat rows and chill 20 minutes. Bake at 150C for 45 minutes until pale gold, sprinkle with sugar and cut into fingers while warm.

d.note: four chickens and a cola, Jake's order
d.how: Chill four glass bottles of cola in the fridge for at least three hours. Pop the caps, drop a straw into each and serve alongside the chicken.
